column4: dialect-gated: cleat#3572 regression test, one function per dialect (same shape as a-stale-concurrency-key-of-another-tenant-is-reaped-on-sql-server.tsv beside it) so the SQL Server arm skips on its own without taking the PostgreSQL arm with it. This job (./cmd/..., CLEAT_TEST_DB only) supplies no SQL Server, so exactly this function skips. It FAILS rather than skips when CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is set and the server is unreachable (mssqlHBRig), so the skip can only mean "this job has no SQL Server".
